settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: The theme only changes colors; light/dark is controlled separately by Appearance.
settings.shortcutsTip: Configure global shortcuts for quick actions: click a field and press a key combination to record (Esc cancels).
settings.name: Name
settings.namePlaceholder: App name shown at the top-left corner
settings.sloganPlaceholder: Welcome text on the empty state, e.g. What can I help you with?
settings.baseUrlRequired: Please fill in the base URL first
settings.headersPlaceholder: Optional JSON object; the session placeholder is replaced with the current conversation ID on chat requests (see example below)
settings.headersInvalid: Request headers must be a valid JSON object
settings.modelsPlaceholder: One model ID per line, e.g. deepseek-chat
settings.modelPlaceholder: Select or type a model ID
settings.contextWindowHint: Context window defaults to {0} tokens and can be edited per model
settings.providerTip: Uses the OpenAI-compatible protocol; works with DeepSeek / Ollama / vLLM, etc.
settings.dataDirTip: Chats, messages, providers and settings are stored in a single SQLite file in this directory. Restart to apply changes.
settings.dataDirPlaceholder: Absolute path to the data directory
settings.relaunchDevTip: Auto-restart is unavailable in development. Please run npm run dev again manually.
settings.dataDirSaved: Data directory saved. Restart to apply.
settings.runtimeTip: Node / Python used by the agent's command execution and the terminal panel. Node defaults to the built-in one (Electron); leave Python empty to auto-detect the system interpreter.
settings.pythonAutoTip: Leave empty to auto-detect the system interpreter
settings.nodeBuiltinTip: Use the app's built-in Node (ships with Electron)
settings.nodePathPlaceholder: Path to the Node executable, e.g. /usr/local/bin/node
settings.pythonPathPlaceholder: Path to the Python interpreter; leave empty to auto-detect python3 / python
settings.developerTip: Developer mode is for local troubleshooting only. When enabled, model requests, responses, and tool calls are recorded and a Diagnostics tab appears in the tool panel. Data stays in the local database.
